labels.scheduler_patrol: 在已存在订阅上巡逻到期槽位并只产生调度 receipt
labels.read_committed_subscription_state: 读取已提交订阅状态并复核版本
labels.recover_pending_reminder: 空闲恢复待提醒槽位或按 late-skip 原子收口槽位与提醒
labels.claim_due_occurrence: 原子比较状态版本后认领到期执行
labels.validate_occurrence_domain: 校验 occurrence 领域状态与触发规则
labels.admit_occurrence_execution: 取得 occurrence 消费权，准备精确 child allocation 并读取该次 TaskGrant
labels.execute_occurrence_task: 仅在精确授权后由 native TG1 owner 启动或恢复一次 serve-task
labels.settle_occurrence: 消费验证后终态与结算 receipt 并原子消费 occurrence
labels.publish_occurrence_result: 仅按验证终态发布周期任务结果与恢复责任
